    • backPropagate

      public double[][] backPropagate(double[][] deltas)
      BACKPROPAGATION IMPLEMENTATION Mathematical Derivation: Forward Pass: 1. Q = X * W_q + b_q (queries) 2. K = X * W_k + b_k (keys) 3. V = X * W_v + b_v (values) 4. scores = Q * K^T / sqrt(d_k) (scaled dot product) 5. attention = softmax(scores) (attention weights) 6. output = attention * V (head output) Backward Pass (Chain Rule): Given dL/dOutput from the next layer: 1. dL/dAttention = dL/dOutput * V^T 2. dL/dScores = softmax_derivative(scores) * dL/dAttention 3. dL/dQ = dL/dScores * K / sqrt(d_k) 4. dL/dK = dL/dScores^T * Q / sqrt(d_k) 5. dL/dV = dL/dOutput^T * attention 6. dL/dW_q = X^T * dL/dQ 7. dL/dW_k = X^T * dL/dK 8. dL/dW_v = X^T * dL/dV 9. dL/dInput = dL/dQ * W_q^T + dL/dK * W_k^T + dL/dV * W_v^T
      Specified by:
      backPropagate in interface Backpropagation
      Parameters:
      deltas - The delta from the mha of this head (dL/dOutput)
      Returns:
      The new deltas for the next backpropagation step (dL/dInput)
